generalSettings.title: General settings

securitySettings.title: Security configuration
securitySettings.subtitle: Control session lifetime and TOTP window for the club. Changes require fresh TOTP confirmation and apply to new sessions.
securitySettings.idleWindowHelp: How long a session stays active without any request. Valid: 30–43,200 min (30 min – 30 days). Default: 720 min (12 h).
securitySettings.absoluteCapHelp: Hard ceiling from login time. Must be ≥ idle window. Valid: up to 129,600 min (90 days). Default: 10,080 min (7 days).
securitySettings.adminTotpWindowHelp: How long an admin TOTP step-up stays open. Valid: 5–1,440 min. Default: 720 min (12 h).
securitySettings.newSessionsNote: Session timeouts affect new sessions and the next extension of existing ones. The TOTP window takes effect immediately for all sessions.

feedbackSettings.incompleteWarning: Fill in all three fields before enabling. The widget will show a 'not configured' error otherwise.

economySettings.title: Economy settings
economySettings.paymentAccountsHint: Clearing account for Vipps payouts, and the fee account for online payment fees (Vipps and card). Defaults are 2900 and 7700.
economySettings.onlineMaxAmountHint: Invoices over this amount are offered bank transfer (KID) only, so the club avoids payment fees. Applies to Vipps and card alike. Leave empty for no limit.
economySettings.vippsAutoAssignTieCategory: When an amount fits several price categories
economySettings.vippsAutoAssignHint: Books a payment only when it clearly matches one member's single open faktura, or one price category. Everything else stays in Tildel. Every booking can be undone.
economySettings.stripeAccountsHint: The clearing account holds card payments until Stripe pays them out (default 1580, an active asset account). The payout text is a regular expression that recognises a Stripe payout in the bank statement (default (?i)stripe).
economySettings.subtitle: Faktura defaults, registered bank accounts, and (soon) Vipps merchant configuration — everything the accounting module needs in one place.
economySettings.fakturaLogoHint: PNG or JPEG, max 2 MB. Used on the faktura PDF (rasterized).
economySettings.kidMethodHint: Must match the club's OCR/Nets agreement. Modulo 11 is the Norwegian OCR-giro default. This only affects newly generated KIDs — use «New KID» on the Sent tab to reissue existing unpaid invoices.
economySettings.logoSizeError: Logo must be 2 MB or smaller.

exemptions.label: Role exemptions
exemptions.hint: Board roles that are not charged for a price item or a whole price category. Fakturas still show the full price, with an offsetting "Fritak" line, so the waived amount is booked as an expense rather than lost revenue. Nothing is exempt until you add it here.
exemptions.accountHint: The waived amount is debited to this account and the item's revenue is credited in full. Required when any exemption is set.
exemptions.accountRequired: Choose the expense account exemptions are booked to.

economySettings.bankAutoAssign: Book unambiguous bank payments without KID automatically
economySettings.bankAutoAssignHint: After each bank upload and Synk bank, books a payment without KID only when the payer's name matches exactly one member who has exactly one open faktura for the same amount. Everything else stays in Tildel. Every booking can be undone. Separate from the Vipps setting.

salgsvilkar.title: Sales terms
salgsvilkar.intro: These sales terms govern purchases and services offered by {club}, including memberships, berth rentals, guest harbor and motorhome stays, event tickets, and merchandise.

parter.title: Parties
parter.body: These terms apply between {club} ("the club", "we", "us"), org.no. {orgNumber}, as seller, and the buyer ("you", "the buyer") who places an order through the club's online services or in person.

betaling.title: Payment
betaling.body: Payment is made via the channels we offer — typically Vipps, card (including Apple Pay and Google Pay), bank transfer with KID, or invoice. The amount due, payment deadline, and KID number are stated on the invoice/order confirmation. Late payment may incur reminder fees and interest in accordance with the Late Payment Interest Act (forsinkelsesrenteloven).

oppsigelse.title: Cancellation and stopping recurring payments
oppsigelse.body: There is no binding period. You can cancel your membership or stop a recurring payment/charge at any time. To cancel, contact {club} by email {email}{phone}. Recurring Vipps agreements can also be cancelled yourself in the Vipps app under "Agreements". Cancellation takes effect from the next billing period, after which you will not be charged again. Membership fees already paid are normally not refunded.

levering.title: Delivery
levering.body: Digital goods (memberships, berth assignments, guest harbor stays) take effect immediately upon registered payment. Physical merchandise is delivered by post or for pickup at the harbor master's hut as agreed at checkout. Expected delivery time is stated for each product.

angrerett.title: Right of withdrawal
angrerett.body: For digital services that begin immediately at your request (e.g. a guest slip booking for the same day, a confirmed member registration), the right of withdrawal lapses once delivery has started, in accordance with the Norwegian Right of Withdrawal Act (angrerettloven) §22. For physical merchandise you have 14 days from receipt to cancel without giving a reason. Contact the treasurer to use your right of withdrawal.

retur.title: Returns
retur.body: Returned merchandise must be unused and in its original condition. You cover the return shipping unless the goods are defective. Refunds are paid back to the same payment method used for the purchase, normally within 14 days of receipt of the returned goods.

reklamasjon.title: Complaints handling
reklamasjon.body: If something is wrong with the product or service, contact us as soon as possible — and at the latest within reasonable time after the defect was or should have been discovered. The deadline for complaints is two years from receipt, or five years for items intended for significantly longer use. Send complaints to the treasurer or, for harbor-related matters, the harbor master.

konflikt.title: Dispute resolution
konflikt.body: We aim to resolve any disagreement amicably. If we cannot agree, the buyer can bring the matter before the Consumer Council (Forbrukertilsynet) or the Consumer Disputes Commission (Forbrukerklageutvalget). EU consumers can use the European Commission's online dispute resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/odr. Norwegian law applies and Norwegian courts are the venue.
